notes.problem: The slips and tiles sit small in a thin sand strip under haze.
notes.fix: Low three quarter view on the interrogating slip filling half the frame, the accepting slip a soft second plane, remove the dot tiles.

notes.problem: Slips in a thin strip under haze, sand, a toy pen.
notes.fix: Camera at about 25 degrees pushed in on a chipped limestone lip, a satin pen with a tight contact shadow.

notes.problem: Two small slips in a thin strip of sand between haze and footer; pen reads cyan blue.
notes.fix: Low rake and push in so the slips span 80 percent of the width; recolour the pen indigo.

notes.problem: A distant isometric dollhouse with mannequin people, a thin rod divider and a flat floor.
notes.fix: Push in to the glass at eye height with the workstations facing across it, glass with thickness and reflection, figures cropped at the shoulder.

notes.problem: A stray cyan shard beside the glass, mannequins, flat floors, the cutaway under half the frame.
notes.fix: Delete the shard or make it a real reflection of both monitors; lower and enlarge the cutaway to meet the footer.

notes.problem: Thin glass focal, mannequin figures at dollhouse scale, a four line dek on a wash.
notes.fix: Crop in on the two cart screens across a modelled glass pane, rooms bleeding off the edges, two line dek.

notes.problem: Cabinets least modelled, a muddy lower third, the table is not a 100 point scale so the sheets misstate their share.
notes.fix: Set the table top to exactly 100 x 0.02 m or print a 100 mark, crop tighter on the tops, warm the floor.

notes.problem: Boxy tables with lumpy vinyl noise, no visible roll or curl, pills on the vinyl, a dead peach lower band.
notes.fix: Chrome dispenser bar and roll at each head, a curled free end with its own shadow, a stitched vinyl seam, pills on the sweep, camera in about 20 percent.

notes.problem: Clipped white coat, jagged hair alpha, the chair cutting the body, c11 c7 over the chair, a flat bench shadow block.
notes.fix: Lower the key on the coat with fold normals, fix the hair and chair intersection, swing the camera so the figure clears the claim id corner.

notes.problem: Trays read as ending at the bench edge; pills loose on the bench.
notes.fix: Run each track to a cyan pan at the laptop's side and seat each pill against its tray.

notes.problem: Laptops hover on an offset shadow and the binder sits in a halo, under half the frame.
notes.fix: Set both on a desk with tight contact shadows from one key and push in until they fill half the frame.

notes.problem: Laptops float on an offset halo; sleep lights merge.
notes.fix: Set the stack down with a hard contact shadow and separate the lights.

notes.problem: A stretched slab face, loose tiles, a small laptop.
notes.fix: Rail off the left edge toward the lens, the zero carriage sharp in the foreground, retexture the slab, remove the tiles.

notes.problem: The lit cyan rocker end reads as on at feed size.
notes.fix: Make the proud end a dead matte cyan or move the cyan to a small unlit AI pilot lamp.
